scope: DEV-only whole-chunk Silero cap30 acoustic presence precheck using original unpatched ASR and production gate/context/reconcile. No held-out access, downloads, production edits or phone-performance claim.
classification: Report-only assembly recovered after completed inference; original frozen run remains failed.

binding.classification: Deterministic report recovery, no new inference; original failed status preserved.

asr.source_checkout_note: Informational checkout only; binary/library hashes identify the measured engine, not proof it was built from this checkout.

vad.source_checkout_note: Informational checkout only; binary/library hashes identify the measured engine, not proof it was built from this checkout.

conditioning.partial_tail: Use actual remaining samples for RMS and release; no added samples
conditioning.pcm: Signed little-endian PCM16; float64 numpy.rint ties-to-even; reject clipping
conditioning.state: Reset once per source stream; no lookahead beyond the current 512-sample frame

policy.presence: ASR iff native VAD ranges are nonempty; never crop, split, extend, amplify or pad the ASR input.
policy.state: Reset VAD recurrent state and causal conditioner once per original production chunk or direct control WAV.
policy.skip: Do not invoke ASR, store profile=null and no native ASR JSON. Feed empty decoded list through actual frozen Kotlin reconcile to preserve the ordinary uncertain review cue.
policy.errors: Malformed, truncated, mismatched or failed VAD rejects the run; it must never be treated as absence.

speech_drop_review.limits: Lexical support is not acoustic/word-time alignment. No automatic adoption even when numeric gates pass.

timing.scope: Cold host VAD and ASR processes, with VAD overhead recorded separately. This run does not rank speed or establish phone behavior.
